Class GameUI

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
aslframework.ui.GameUI
public class GameUI extends javafx.application.Application
Main JavaFX UI for the ASL learning platform.

Single-mode layout:

  • Left – live camera feed via CameraService
  • Right – instruction panel with video placeholder (swap out later)
  • Bottom – scoring dashboard: attempts, avg accuracy, pass count, streak, log

Hold logic: a gesture is only recorded once it has been detected confidently (score >= 0.8) for HOLD_DURATION_MS milliseconds without switching letters.

All public update methods are safe to call from the background recognition thread — they delegate to Platform.runLater(Runnable) internally.
